description.narrative: The most significant, expected Project-level outcome is increased access to finance for Moroccan borrowers and ensure continuity as SG phases out its temporary bridge guarantee to its former Moroccan subsidiary. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the proposed investment will strengthen the resilience of Morocco's financial market and sustain lending to key corporate players in the manufacturing, fertilizers and food security.

The project is an IFC investment through an unfunded risk participation (URP) of up to US$250 million equivalent for IFCs own account, covering a portfolio of eligible borrowers. The URP has been executed with Société Générale SA (SG) in France before, transitioning to a direct URP with Saham Bank in Morocco, ensuring continuity in lending to strategic sectors in Morocco and supporting Saham Banks operations under Sahams sponsorship.
